title: OL-20261113-2: The executor repairs an adopted pull request in place
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** next executor pass after the lane adoption merges
**Done check:** grep:foundation/executor.py::OL-PR-
**Status:** closed

The lane files OL-PR-<n> for a pull request it cannot merge, and the executor takes it like any item: it writes a new change from main. It cannot yet check out the pull request branch, read the failing check log and push a fix there, so a large pull request is redone instead of repaired. Change: in foundation/executor.py, when the picked item id starts with OL-PR-, fetch the head branch, add the failed check output (gh run view --log-failed) to the prompt, apply the edits on that branch and push; close the pull request as superseded only when the repair fails twice. Closing probe: foundation/executor.py handles OL-PR- items and a test covers it.

**Evidence:** foundation/executor.py pr_repair repairs an adopted pull request on its own branch and supersede_pr closes a replaced one; tests/foundation/test_executor.py PrRepair, 3 tests pass.
